lines.english: “Huh!? Wh… what?”

lines.japanese: またしても、顎が頬杖からかくんと外れ…
lines.english: Once again, my chin slipped from the hand propping it up—

lines.japanese: そして周りの色が一変していることに気づいた。
lines.english: and I realized the colors around me had changed completely.
“Touma…?”

lines.japanese:
闇に覆われつつある音楽室は、ぼやけた視界とあいまって、
もう、ほとんど何も見えなくなっていた。
lines.english: Between my blurred vision and the darkness gathering in the music room, I could barely see a thing.

lines.japanese:
外から聞こえてくる同級生たちの喧騒も、
陽が沈むとともに、少しずつ静まってきてる。
lines.english: Outside, the clamor of our classmates was fading little by little with the setting sun.

lines.japanese: 「帰っちゃったか…」
lines.english: “Guess she went home…”

lines.japanese: 頭を振りつつ、意識が飛ぶ前の記憶を探る。
lines.english: I shook my head and went searching for the last thing I remembered before drifting off.

lines.japanese:
俺は確かに冬馬と一緒にいて、
俺たちのステージに対してのダメ出しと、
進路の話と、時候の挨拶と…
lines.english: I had definitely been here with Touma. We had gone over everything wrong with our performance, talked about our futures, exchanged seasonal greetings…

lines.japanese:
もっと踏み込んだ話題があったはずだけど、
起き抜けの思考が追いついていかない。
lines.english: There had been something more personal than that, I was sure. But my thoughts, fresh from sleep, couldn’t catch up.

lines.japanese: あの時、確かに俺は彼女に…
lines.english: I was sure I had said something to her…

lines.japanese: 「おはよ」
lines.english: “Morning.”

lines.japanese:
そんなふうに、惚けたまま、
自分の言葉を反芻していたら…
lines.english: As I sat there dazed, turning my own words over in my mind,

lines.japanese:
突然、ささやくような、でも艶めかしい声が、
俺の顔に触る。
lines.english: A sudden voice, hushed yet sultry, brushed against my face.

lines.japanese:
「おはよ春希くん。
そして、お疲れさま」
lines.english: “Morning, Haruki. And nice work today.”
“Setsuna…?”

lines.japanese:
…比喩じゃなくて、本当に息が顔に触れた。
それほど、至近距離だった。
lines.english: It wasn’t a metaphor. Her breath really did touch my face. That was how close she was.

lines.japanese:
膝立ちで、俺の視線の高さにぴったり合わせ、
薄暗がりの中、穴が開くほどに俺の顔を見つめてる。
lines.english: She was kneeling to bring her eyes level with mine, studying my face intently enough to bore a hole through it in the dim light.

lines.japanese: 「え、ええと…クラスの方は？」
lines.english: “Um… what happened with your class?”

lines.japanese:
「とっくに終わったよ。
もうすぐ６時だもん」
lines.english: “We finished ages ago. It’s almost six.”

lines.japanese:
「…もうそんな時間なのか。
だいぶ寝てたなぁ」
lines.english: “It’s that late already? I really was out for a while.”

lines.japanese:
「そうだね。
わたしが来てからでも、３０分以上」
lines.english: “You were. It’s been over half an hour just since I got here.”

lines.japanese: 「起こしてくれよ…」
lines.english: “You should’ve woken me…”

lines.japanese: 「嫌だよ」
lines.english: “I didn’t want to.”

lines.japanese:
「そんなに気を使ってくれなくてもいいって。
だいたい、疲れてるのはお互い…」
lines.english: “You don’t have to be that considerate. Besides, we’re both exhausted—”

lines.japanese:
「そんなことしたら、
春希くんの寝顔がゆっくり楽しめないよ。
もったいない」
lines.english: “But then I wouldn’t have had all that time to enjoy your sleeping face. What a waste that would’ve been.”

lines.japanese: 「…冗談だよな？」
lines.english: “…You’re joking, right?”

lines.japanese: 「冗談だって言ってくれよ」
lines.english: “Tell me you’re joking.”

lines.japanese: 「ふふっ」
lines.english: “Hee hee.”

lines.japanese:
「だから！
からかったって言ってくれっての！」
lines.english: “Come on! Tell me you were teasing!”

lines.japanese: 「あはっ…や～だよ～だ」
lines.english: “Ahaha… No way.”

lines.japanese:
それどころか、俺が目覚めても、
まだ俺の顔を見つめることをやめてくれないし。
lines.english: Even now that I was awake, she showed no sign of taking her eyes off my face.

lines.japanese:
「ふあぁぁぁ～…つつつっ！
あ～、体のあちこちが痛い」
lines.english: “Yaaawn… Ow! God, I ache all over.”

lines.japanese: 椅子から立ち上がり、思い切り伸びをする。
lines.english: I got up from the chair and stretched as hard as I could.

lines.japanese: もちろん、照れ隠し以外の何物でもない。
lines.english: Purely to hide my embarrassment, of course.

lines.japanese:
「頑張ったもんね今日。
ううん、今日だけじゃなくて、今週ずっと」
lines.english: “You worked hard today. No—you’ve worked hard all week.”

lines.japanese: 「そんなのは雪菜だって…あれ？」
lines.english: “So did you… Wait.”

lines.japanese:
と、その時になってやっと気づいたのが、
肩に掛けられている、暖かなコート。
lines.english: Only then did I notice the warm coat draped over my shoulders.

lines.japanese:
ちょっと軽めで、
暗がりの中でもわかるくらいの赤系で、
そして、どう見ても男物じゃなくて。
lines.english: Light, with a reddish color I could make out even in the dark—and unmistakably not a man’s.

lines.japanese: 「これ…雪菜が？」
lines.english: “Did you put this over me?”

lines.japanese:
「お母さんが持ってきてくれてたんだ。
昨日、家に帰らなかったから、着替えだって」
lines.english: “My mother brought it. I didn’t come home last night, so she brought me a change of clothes.”

lines.japanese: 「………まさに色々とごめん」
lines.english: “…I’m sorry about so many things.”

lines.japanese:
俺を気遣ってくれたこととか、
着替えが必要な原因を作ってしまったこととか。
lines.english: For making her look after me. For being the reason she’d needed fresh clothes in the first place.

lines.japanese:
…目の前の雪菜は、やっぱりステージ衣装のままで、
今の時間だと、見るからに寒そうなこととか。
lines.english: And because Setsuna was still in her stage costume, and by this hour looked painfully cold.

lines.japanese:
「返すよ。
…本当に悪い。こういうの男の役目なのに」
lines.english: “Here. And I really am sorry. I’m supposed to be the one giving you my coat.”

lines.japanese:
「ううん。
春希くんは、十分男の子の役目、果たしたよ？」
lines.english: “No. You’ve already played the gentleman for me today.”

lines.japanese:
コートを差し出すと、
雪菜は俺に、無防備に背中をさらす。
lines.english: When I held out the coat, Setsuna turned her unguarded back to me.

lines.japanese:
俺はなんとか理由を聞くことなく、
その肩に、ゆっくりコートをかけていく。
lines.english: I managed not to ask what she meant as I settled it gently over her shoulders.

lines.japanese:
「わたしに勇気をくれた。
あの高い場所で、たくさんの人に向かって、
それでも楽しく歌える勇気を」
lines.english: “You gave me courage. The courage to stand in that high place, sing to all those people… and enjoy every second of it.”

lines.japanese: 「そんなこと…ないって」
lines.english: “That’s… not true.”

lines.japanese: 本当に勇気づけられたのは俺の方だし。
lines.english: I was the one she had given courage to.

lines.japanese:
あの絶望的な状況で、
しかも諦めることが致命的でもない状況で、
ただ俺のワガママだけで突き進んでいた状況で。
lines.english: When everything looked hopeless, when quitting would hardly have ruined anyone’s life, when nothing but my own selfishness kept me pushing forward—

lines.japanese:
一番最初に、俺の理解者になってくれて、
二番目の理解者を一生懸命引き込んでくれて、
いつも、俺たちを明るく照らす役目であり続けてくれて。
lines.english: she had been the first person to understand me, had worked tirelessly to win over the second, and had never stopped being the light that kept us going.

lines.japanese:
…時々拗ねたりして完璧じゃないところが、
また、俺に強い責任感を与えてくれて。
lines.english: And every now and then she would sulk—just enough not to be perfect, and to make me feel all the more responsible for her.

lines.japanese: 「た～のしかったね～」
lines.english: “That was so much fuuun.”

lines.japanese: 「めちゃくちゃ、な」
lines.english: “Insanely.”

lines.japanese:
「人前で歌うのって、ものすごく緊張するけど、
一線を越えちゃったら二度とやめられなくなりそう」
lines.english: “Singing in front of people is terrifying, but once you cross that line, I think it could become addictive.”

lines.japanese:
そんな雪菜が、俺に背中を向けたまま、
あの時の余韻を噛みしめるように、暗い天井を見上げる。
lines.english: Still facing away from me, Setsuna looked up at the dark ceiling, lingering over the memory.

lines.japanese:
「うん、今でも覚えてる。
あのスポットライトに照らされて歌ったんだなぁ」
lines.english: “I still remember it. I really stood under that spotlight and sang.”

lines.japanese:
その視線の先に、まばゆいライトが見えるのか、
暗闇に手をかざし、眩しそうに光をさえぎる。
lines.english: As if she could see the dazzling light there, she raised a hand into the darkness to shield her eyes from its glare.

lines.japanese: 「…そういえば振りつけとか全然やらなかったね」
lines.english: “…We never did work out any choreography, did we?”

lines.japanese:
「そんなことは些細な問題だ。
誰も気にしてなかった」
lines.english: “A trivial detail. Nobody cared.”

lines.japanese:
だって、ステージ上の彼女たちは、
掛け値なしに綺麗だったから。
lines.english: Because the girls on that stage had been beautiful. No exaggeration.

lines.japanese:
一番至近距離で見てた、
世界一の贅沢者が言うんだから間違いない。
lines.english: Take it from the luckiest man alive, who had enjoyed the best seat in the house.

lines.japanese:
「あ～…歓声が耳に残ってる。
当分忘れられそうにないな。
目を閉じると、まだ夢の中にいるみたい」
lines.english: “Ahh… I can still hear the cheering. I don’t think I’ll forget it for a long time. Close my eyes, and it feels like I’m still dreaming.”

lines.japanese:
「じゃあ、またやるか？
俺はともかく、雪菜と冬馬がいれば、
もっと大きなイベントだって…」
lines.english: “Then what if we do it again? Forget me—with you and Touma, we could play something even bigger…”

lines.japanese: 冬馬にはけんもほろろに断られたけどな…
lines.english: Touma had already rejected that idea without a second thought…

lines.japanese: 「ね、春希くん」
lines.english: “Haruki?”
“Hm?”

lines.japanese: 「これからも、ずっと一緒にいてね？」
lines.english: “Stay with me forever, okay?”

lines.japanese: 「…雪菜さえよければ」
lines.english: “…If that’s what you want.”

lines.japanese:
そしてやっぱり、
雪菜の方にも態度を保留された。
lines.english: And once again, Setsuna had left the question hanging.

lines.japanese: そりゃ、楽しさ以上にあれだけ苦労もあれば、か。
lines.english: Given how much trouble had come with the fun, I supposed that was only natural.

lines.japanese:
「峰城大、行くんだよね？
文系だよね？　どこの学部狙い？」
lines.english: “You’re going on to Houjou University, right? In the humanities? Which department are you aiming for?”
lines.japaneseRuby:
「[R峰城大^うえ]、行くんだよね？
文系だよね？　どこの学部狙い？」

lines.japanese: 「え？　いや、今のところ政経のつもりだけど…」
lines.english: “Huh? Political science and economics, probably…”

lines.japanese: 「むぅ…英文行かない？」
lines.english: “Hmm… Wouldn’t you consider English literature?”

lines.japanese: 「いや俺英語苦手だし。相対的に」
lines.english: “I’m bad at English. Relatively speaking.”

lines.japanese: 「わたしだって政治も経済も苦手だよ。絶対的に」
lines.english: “I’m bad at politics and economics. In absolute terms.”

lines.japanese:
「無理に学部まで合わせる必要ないだろ。
今まで通り同じ学校に通うんだから、毎日会えるし」
lines.english: “We don’t have to force ourselves into the same department. We’ll still be at the same school, just like now. We can see each other every day.”

lines.japanese:
「毎日も重要だけど、
一日何時間ってのも重要じゃないかな？」
lines.english: “Every day matters, but so does how many hours we get each day, don’t you think?”

lines.japanese:
「そもそも教養課程では一緒の講義も多いし。
何でそんなに選択を急ぐんだよ？」
lines.english: “We’ll share plenty of general-education classes anyway. Why are you in such a hurry to decide?”

lines.japanese: 「それは…そうなんだけど…ね」
lines.english: “That’s… true, but…”

lines.japanese:
「今はそんな先の話より、目先の約束。
進学しても、また三人で何かやりたいな。
雪菜と、冬馬と、俺と…」
lines.english: “Forget the distant future. Let’s make a promise about what comes next. Once we’re at university, I want the three of us to do something together again. You, Touma, and me…”

lines.japanese: 「雪菜？」
lines.english: “Setsuna?”

lines.japanese: 「一緒にいてね、春希くん」
lines.english: “Stay with me, Haruki.”

lines.japanese: 「あ？　ああ…」
lines.english: “Huh? Oh…”

lines.japanese: 雪菜が…ちょっと違う？
lines.english: Something was… different about Setsuna.

lines.japanese:
「進学しても、二年になっても、
三年になって、もしも学部が違っても…」
lines.english: “When we start university, when we’re in our second year, then our third—even if we end up in different departments…”

lines.japanese: 「雪菜？」
lines.english: “Setsuna?”

lines.japanese:
つい数時間前、
ステージの上で、満員の観衆を翻弄してたときと違う。
lines.english: She was different from the girl who, only hours ago, had held a packed audience in the palm of her hand.

lines.japanese:
「もしもわたしが留年して、
春希くんの後輩になっちゃったとしても」
lines.english: “Even if I repeat a year and end up one year behind you.”

lines.japanese: 「普通にやってれば留年なんかしないって…」
lines.english: “You won’t repeat a year if you put in even a normal amount of effort…”

lines.japanese:
つい数日前、
冬馬の家のスタジオで、
自信に満ち溢れた歌声を響かせていたときとも違う。
lines.english: She was different, too, from the girl whose confident voice had filled Touma’s studio only days ago.

lines.japanese:
「もしも、もしも…
ええと、ええとね…」
lines.english: “Even if… even if… Um… um…”

lines.japanese:
「落ち着けって。
今、明かりつけるから…」
lines.english: “Calm down. I’ll turn on the light—”

lines.japanese: 似ているとすれば、昨日の朝。
lines.english: If she resembled anyone, it was the Setsuna of yesterday morning:

lines.japanese:
雪菜を連れ去りに、３年Ａ組を訪れたときの、
おどおどして、何だか小さく見えてしまった、あの…
lines.english: the timid girl who had looked so small when I went to carry her off from Class 3-A—that…

lines.japanese: 「駄目！」
lines.english: “No!”

lines.japanese:
あのときの雪菜と同じ雪菜が…
電灯のスイッチに伸びた、俺の手に絡みつく。
lines.english: The same Setsuna I had seen yesterday morning entwined her hand with mine as I reached for the light switch.

lines.japanese:
「やめようよ…
夢が覚めちゃうよ」
lines.english: “Don’t… You’ll wake me from the dream.”

lines.japanese:
そう、絡みあう。
俺の右手と、雪菜の左手が…
lines.english: Yes, entwined: my right hand and Setsuna’s left…

lines.japanese: 「ね、春希くん」
lines.english: “Haruki.”
“Setsuna…?”

lines.japanese:
指の一本一本、すべてを重ねあわせ、
その柔らかい手のひらで、包み込もうとする。
lines.english: One by one, she laid every finger against mine and tried to fold her soft palm around my hand.

lines.japanese: 「今日のわたしは、ずっと夢を見続けてたい」
lines.english: “Today, I want to keep dreaming forever.”

lines.japanese:
あのときの雪菜と同じに見えて、
けれど、何か違うものを内に秘めた雪菜が…
lines.english: She looked like the Setsuna from that morning, yet held something different hidden inside her…

lines.japanese:
ただ下ろしていただけの、
もう一つの俺の手にも繋がる。
lines.english: She took my other hand too, the one that had been hanging at my side.

lines.japanese:
「スポットライトを浴びて、大歓声を受けて、
大好きな歌を、心から楽しく歌って」
lines.english: “Basking in the spotlight, hearing the crowd roar, singing the song I love with all my heart…”

lines.japanese:
絡みあう。
俺の左手と、雪菜の右手…
lines.english: Entwined: my left hand and Setsuna’s right…

lines.japanese: 「それで、みんなも喜んでくれて」
lines.english: “And making everyone else happy too.”

lines.japanese:
暗がりの中…
届くのは、雪菜の熱い息遣いと、
わずかな光に照らされて輝く瞳。
lines.english: In the darkness, all that reached me was Setsuna’s heated breath and her eyes shining in what little light remained.

lines.japanese:
「好きな人に、誉められて…
だから調子に乗って、ごほうびを、ねだって…」
lines.english: “Then the person I love praised me… so I got carried away and asked him for a reward…”

lines.japanese:
そして…
聞く人によっては、紛らわしいことこの上ない、
勘違いを誘発する、告白みたいなたとえ話。
lines.english: And then… a story so open to misunderstanding that, to the wrong ears, it could sound almost like a confession.

lines.japanese:
「そしたらその人が、ちょっと苦笑いして、
甘えん坊のわたしを、やさしく抱きしめて…」
lines.english: “Then he gives this little rueful smile and gently takes needy little me in his arms…”

lines.japanese: 「せつ…な…」
lines.english: “Set… suna…”

lines.japanese: 「…でも、ちょっと想像してたのと違うね、これ」
lines.english: “…Though this isn’t quite how I imagined it.”

lines.japanese:
雪菜の肩から、
俺がせっかくかけてあげたコートがふわりと落ちる。
lines.english: The coat I had so carefully placed around her shoulders fluttered to the floor.

lines.japanese:
それは、雪菜が動いたから。
繋いだ両手を胸の前に、
額をこつんと、俺の胸に。
lines.english: Setsuna had moved, lifting our joined hands between us and resting her forehead lightly against my chest.

lines.japanese:
「こんなふうに、自分の方から迫っちゃうなんて、
計画のうちにはなかったんだけどな」
lines.english: “I never planned on being the one to make the first move.”

lines.japanese:
さっきまで、俺の顔にかかっていた吐息は、
今は、俺の胸を温かく湿らせる。
lines.english: The breath that had warmed my face now fell damp and hot against my chest.

lines.japanese:
「あくまでもわたしは受け身で…
ちょっとびっくりしたけど、
でも、ずっと待ってたんだからいいやって…」
lines.english: “I was supposed to let him make the first move… to be a little surprised, but then decide it was all right, because I’d been waiting so long…”

lines.japanese:
瞳の光は俺の視界から消えたけど、
今度は雪菜の髪の香りが、俺の五感を刺激する。
lines.english: The light in her eyes disappeared from view. In its place, the scent of her hair enveloped me.

lines.japanese:
「…そんな感じの、
都合のいい夢だったんだけどなぁ」
lines.english: “…That was how my convenient little fantasy was supposed to go, anyway.”

lines.japanese:
額だけでなく、頬や耳までも俺の胸に埋めてくる。
…俺の鼓動を聞かれてしまってる。
lines.english: She buried her forehead, her cheek, even her ear against my chest. She could hear my heart pounding.

lines.japanese:
「仕方がないか…
自分の心を掴みきれてなかった
わたしが悪いんだもんね」
lines.english: “I suppose I can’t blame anyone but myself. I never did work out what I really wanted.”
“Ah…”

lines.japanese: 「ね、春希くん…」
lines.english: “Haruki…”

lines.japanese: もう一度、雪菜が顔を上げる。
lines.english: Setsuna lifted her face again.

lines.japanese:
けれどさっきまでと違うのは、
俺との身長の差で…
lines.english: But this time, because of the difference in our height,

lines.japanese: 「よけても、いいんだよ…？」
lines.english: “You can pull away… if you want.”

lines.japanese:
もう、その瞳と、そして唇は、
俺の目の前にまで上り詰めてきていた。
lines.english: her eyes—and her lips—had risen directly before mine.

lines.japanese: 「雪菜…俺…」
lines.english: “Setsuna… I…”
“Ah…”

lines.japanese:
また、雪菜の瞳から光が消える。
なぜなら、まぶたに遮られてしまったから。
lines.english: The light vanished from her eyes again—this time because she had closed them.

lines.japanese: 「いいの…か？」
lines.english: “Is this… really all right?”

lines.japanese: 駄目なのか？
lines.english: Or was it wrong?

lines.japanese: 「本当に俺で…？」
lines.english: “Are you sure you want me…?”

lines.japanese:
ずっと今のままは、駄目なのか？
三人じゃ、駄目なのか？
lines.english: Couldn’t we stay the way we were? Weren’t the three of us enough?

lines.japanese:
それを、俺に決めろって…
そんな、重いことを、俺の心だけでって…
lines.english: She wanted me to make that decision—to decide something so weighty on the strength of my feelings alone…

lines.japanese: 「雪菜…」
lines.english: “Setsuna…”

lines.japanese: だったら俺は…
lines.english: Then I would—

lines.japanese:
自分で決断して。自分で動いて。
自分で結果を受け入れて…
lines.english: decide for myself, act for myself, and accept the consequences myself.

lines.japanese:
まだ、ほんの十数年だけど、
それでも、自分の意志を持ってからこれまで、
ずっとそうやって生きてきた俺は…
lines.english: It had only been a dozen-odd years, but ever since I’d learned to think for myself, that was how I’d lived…
“Mm… nn…”

lines.japanese:
自分の意志で、雪菜の唇に、
自分を重ね合わせる。
lines.english: And by my own choice, I met Setsuna’s lips with mine.

lines.japanese: 雪菜は…抵抗なんかするわけがなかった。
lines.english: Setsuna offered no resistance. Of course she didn’t.

lines.japanese: 「ん、ん…んぅっ」
lines.english: “Mm… mmm… nn…”

lines.japanese: 雪菜の唇が、俺の唇に、本当に張りついてる。
lines.english: Setsuna’s lips really were pressed to mine.

lines.japanese: 生温かくて、柔らかくて、滑らかで…
lines.english: Warm, soft, smooth…

lines.japanese:
『これが女の子の唇なんだ』なんて、
とても一般論で片付けられそうになくて。
lines.english: There was no reducing it to some general observation like, So this is what a girl’s lips feel like.

lines.japanese: 「は、ぁ…んふ、あ、ん…」
lines.english: “Hah… mm… ah… nn…”

lines.japanese:
ほんのちょっと触れてるだけなのに、
心をごっそり持っていかれそうなくらいに、
物凄い感覚で。
lines.english: We were barely touching, yet the sheer intensity of it threatened to sweep me away entirely.

lines.japanese: 「は、ぁ…ぁぁ…」
lines.english: “Hah… ahh…”

lines.japanese:
俺の口から、思わず吐息が漏れる。
だから雪菜の吐息も俺の顔にかかる。
lines.english: A breath escaped me before I could stop it. Setsuna’s breath washed over my face in return.

lines.japanese:
生温かくて、柔らかくて、滑らかな唇の隙間から、
やっぱり、生温かくて、柔らかくて、滑らかな吐息。
lines.english: Warm breath slipped from between those soft, silken lips.

lines.japanese: 「ん…ちゅぅ…あ、ふぁ…ぁぁ…」
lines.english: “Nn… mmm… ah… haa…”
“Ah… ah…”

lines.japanese: 全身を、電撃が駆け抜けるような痺れが襲う。
lines.english: A jolt shot through my whole body.

lines.japanese:
体中のどこもかしこも緊張し、
自分の神経が、ただ一箇所に集中してしまったみたい。
lines.english: Every muscle in my body seized; every nerve seemed to gather in a single point.

lines.japanese:
そんな、何秒か何年かもわからないくらいの、
軽くてぎこちなくて、そして熱くて激しいキスが
俺たち二人の間を通り過ぎ…
lines.english: For seconds or years—I could no longer tell—a kiss at once light and awkward, searing and fierce, passed between us.

lines.japanese: 「はぁ、はぁ、はぁぁ…あ、あは…」
lines.english: “Hah… hah… haaah… ah… ha ha…”

lines.japanese:
俺の腕の力が緩んだ隙に、
ようやく雪菜が唇を離す。
lines.english: Only when my arms slackened did Setsuna finally draw her lips away.

lines.japanese: …俺の方が雪菜に押しつけていた。
lines.english: I had been the one pressing my lips to hers.

lines.japanese:
「はぁぁ…ふぅ、ん。
あ、あは…あはは…」
lines.english: “Haaah… mm… Ah… ha ha…”

lines.japanese:
けれど雪菜は、そんな強引な俺に、
唇を濡らしたままの笑顔で応えてくれる。
lines.english: Yet Setsuna answered my forcefulness with a smile, her lips still wet.

lines.japanese: 「はぁ…あ…」
lines.english: “Hah… ah…”

lines.japanese:
そして俺の方は…
あまりにも想像を絶する快感に、
果ててしまいそうになっていた。
lines.english: As for me… the pleasure was so far beyond anything I had imagined that I almost came.

lines.japanese: 「ごめん…春希くん」
lines.english: “I’m sorry… Haruki.”

lines.japanese: 「なんで…謝る？」
lines.english: “Why… are you apologizing?”

lines.japanese: 「だって………ファーストキスなんだ」
lines.english: “Because… that was my first kiss.”

lines.japanese: 「雪菜…」
lines.english: “Setsuna…”

lines.japanese: 「ごめんね…」
lines.english: “I’m sorry…”

lines.japanese:
１１月も終わりに近づいたある土曜日。
峰城大付属学園祭二日目。
lines.english: A Saturday near the end of November. The second day of the Houjou High Festival.

lines.japanese:
俺たち三人が、
もっとも近くて楽しくて、
もっとも嬉しかった日。
lines.english: The day the three of us were closest—when we had more fun and were happier than we’d ever been.

lines.japanese: そして…
lines.english: And…

lines.japanese:
俺たち三人が、
本当に三人でいられた、最後の日。
lines.english: the last day the three of us were ever truly three.
